# Specular-path census: lossless GGX base under the coat [measured]

`unx_study_material_layers clearcoat_specpath`. Base: v1 metal, base colour 1 (albedo 1 at every angle), roughness r_b; coat: n 1.5, microsurface multiple scattering, roughness r_c. S_k = energy leaving after exactly k base interactions (S_0 = coat reflection). A base of constant albedo rho gives sum_k S_k rho^k. Photons per angle: 1048576.
